column5: Analyze architecture, components, dependencies, design risks and major technical boundaries.
Inspect repository structure, documentation, configuration and implementation patterns; identify important findings.
Inspect backend and frontend implementation, code organization, defects and maintainability. Do not modify files.
Audit authentication, authorization, secrets, MCP, APIs, dependencies and security configuration.
Analyze tests, testability, coverage gaps, failures and reproducibility; run safe bounded tests where practical.
Perform independent code-quality, correctness and maintainability review.
Inspect CPU, memory, disk, large artifacts, bottlenecks and scalability risks.
Perform QA validation of configuration, startup contracts and regression risks.
